probes.query: SELECT TOP 1 MfgLotId,MfgLotName,CDOTypeId,Qty,SampleRate FROM MfgLot WHERE CDOTypeId=8587 ORDER BY MfgLotId

SELECT s.UpdateSamplingLotHistoryId AS SummaryId,s.SamplingLotId,s.Qty,s.SampleRate,s.Comments AS StoredComments,s.HistoryId,s.HistoryMainlineId,s.TxnId,h.HistoryId AS HeaderHistoryId,h.ContainerId,h.ContainerName,h.Comments,h.TxnType,h.TxnTypeName,h.TxnServiceName,h.TxnServiceSequence,h.ReversalStatus FROM UpdateSamplingLotHistory s INNER JOIN HistoryMainline h ON h.HistoryMainlineId=s.HistoryMainlineId AND h.TxnId=s.TxnId WHERE s.SamplingLotId='0000000000000000' ORDER BY s.UpdateSamplingLotHistoryId OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 2 ROWS ONLY

SELECT TOP 1 s.CollectSamplingDataHistoryId,s.SamplingLotId,s.TxnId,h.ReversalStatus FROM CollectSamplingDataHistory s INNER JOIN HistoryMainline h ON h.HistoryMainlineId=s.HistoryMainlineId AND h.TxnId=s.TxnId WHERE s.SamplingLotId='0000000000000000' AND h.ReversalStatus=1 ORDER BY s.CollectSamplingDataHistoryId

SELECT TOP 1 s.UpdateSamplingLotHistoryId AS SummaryId,s.SamplingLotId,s.Qty,s.SampleRate,s.Comments AS StoredComments,s.HistoryId,s.HistoryMainlineId,s.TxnId,h.HistoryId AS HeaderHistoryId,h.ContainerId,h.ContainerName,h.Comments,h.TxnType,h.TxnTypeName,h.TxnServiceName,h.TxnServiceSequence,h.ReversalStatus FROM UpdateSamplingLotHistory s INNER JOIN HistoryMainline h ON h.HistoryMainlineId=s.HistoryMainlineId AND h.TxnId=s.TxnId ORDER BY s.UpdateSamplingLotHistoryId
